events.verdict: Payton II (GSW) releases away from Thompson (HOU) as they separate following the pick.
Holiday (HOU) legally contests Payton II's (GSW) shot attempt.
Green (GSW) legally contests Smith Jr.'s (HOU) jump shot attempt.
Thompson (HOU) jumps from A to B and initiates body contact with Curry (GSW) as he defends the shot.
Podziemski (GSW) and Smith Jr. (HOU) briefly engage and disengage off-ball.
Sengun (HOU) fails to fully clear the lane and is in the paint for longer than three seconds.
Green (GSW) makes contact with Sengun's (HOU arm/elbow as he defends the shot attempt.
Payton II (GSW) establishes himself in Thompson's (HOU) path prior to the contact.
Sengun (HOU) legally contests Curry's (GSW) jump shot attempt.
Green (GSW) fails to fully clear the lane and is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Melton (GSW) legally contests Durant's (HOU) jump shot attempt.

Green's (GSW) hand momentarily gets caught in Sengun's (HOU) jersey, and he slides his hand off Sengun without pulling his jersey. Green then brings his arm toward the ball, and contact occurs with Sengun's head before Podziemski (GSW) cleanly deflects the ball away. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Smith Jr. (HOU) briefly grasps, and then quickly releases, Green's (GSW) jersey off-ball as the post-entry pass is delivered.
Thompson (HOU) blocks the shot attempt after the ball makes contact with the backboard and has a chance to score.
Melton (GSW) is moving alongside Durant's (HOU) path as he defends the drive.
Podziemski (GSW) establishes, and maintains, a legal guarding position as he defends Sengun's (HOU) shot attempt.
Smith Jr. (HOU) directly contests Curry's (GSW) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Curry's hand after the release.
